fields.summary_ko.0: Seagate Technology (STX) has most of its production allocated to data centers through long-term supply contracts through 2028, making it more directly exposed to AI demand than Apple.
fields.summary_ko.1: Seagate achieved FY2027 Q1 operating margin of 48.9% (versus 26.9% prior year), higher than Apple's 33.0%, and at P/E of 26.3x is undervalued compared to Apple's 38.7x.
